description.en: React components and blocks on shadcn/ui and Base UI with built-in motion and states.
description.zh: 基于 shadcn/ui 与 Base UI 的开源 React 组件与区块库，内置细腻动效与完善的状态交互。

content.en: HextaUI is an open-source library of foundation React components and dashboard blocks designed by Preet Suthar. Built directly on top of shadcn/ui, Base UI primitives, and Tailwind CSS v4, it handles micro-interactions, interruptible animations, keyboard accessibility, high contrast mode, and touch optimizations out of the box. Components are distributable via the shadcn CLI and accompanied by an MCP server for AI coding assistants.
content.zh: HextaUI 是由 Preet Suthar 开发的开源 React 基础组件与区块库。底层基于 shadcn/ui、Base UI 原语和 Tailwind CSS v4 构建，开箱自带丝滑且可中断的过渡动效、严苛的 WCAG 键盘与屏幕阅读器无障碍支持、高对比度模式以及移动端防缩放优化。所有组件支持通过 shadcn CLI 注册表直接拉取源码，并配备专属 MCP 服务方便 AI 编程助手检索与集成。
